# Ronij Barahi

> Ronij Barahi is a graphic designer, logo designer and brand designer based in Kathmandu, Nepal, and cofounder and creative director of the studio Jungle. He designs logos, brand identities, packaging and websites for restaurants, retailers and founders in Nepal, Australia, New Zealand, United States and Canada.

- Based in: Kathmandu, Nepal (UTC+5:45)
- Services: logo design, brand identity, brand guidelines, packaging design, website design
- Quotes: fixed quote after a short brief, in NPR for clients in Nepal and AUD for clients in Australia
- Contact: hello@ronijbarahi.com or https://www.ronijbarahi.com/contact
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ronijbarahi
- Behance: https://www.behance.net/ronijbarahii

## Case studies
- [Bakehouse NY: Baked from scratch since 2016](https://www.ronijbarahi.com/work/bakehouse-ny): Identity, voice and a full brand book for a New York wholesale bakery that makes over a thousand breads, pastries, cakes, cookies and pies.
- [nü cosmetics: Nothing to hide](https://www.ronijbarahi.com/work/nu-cosmetics): Strategy, identity and guidelines for a Nepali beauty brand built on one promise: every claim the customer can check.
- [The Second Plate: Some meals bring you back](https://www.ronijbarahi.com/work/the-second-plate): A restaurant identity built on one idea: the first plate feeds you, the second plate is the one you come back for.
- [Casa Gioia: Baked for beautiful moments](https://www.ronijbarahi.com/work/casa-gioia): A hand lettered identity for a bakery and café: script wordmark, CG monogram, packaging, cups and pattern in sky blue and orange.
- [Ghumgham.com: Nepal's smarter way to travel](https://www.ronijbarahi.com/work/ghumgham): Identity and logo system for a Nepali travel platform, with an English and Devanagari lockup and a monogram built for app icons.
- [Eggs & More: More and more](https://www.ronijbarahi.com/work/eggs-and-more): Identity for a restaurant built around eggs: a chunky wordmark, egg shaped frames, packaging and menus in sunny yellow.
- [Potala Kitchen: Nepali street fuel](https://www.ronijbarahi.com/work/potala-kitchen): Identity for a Nepali street food kitchen: a cheeky mascot in sunglasses, food truck livery, takeaway packaging and menus.
- [Ruby Homes: We build home, not house](https://www.ronijbarahi.com/work/ruby-homes): Identity and launch campaign for a home builder: a gem shaped house mark, a confident magenta palette, signage, uniforms and sales material.
- [Zabardast Biryani: Rooted, rich and bold](https://www.ronijbarahi.com/work/zabardast-biryani): An ornamental identity for a Hyderabadi biryani brand, carried through the interior, menus, packaging, uniforms and an illustrated tee line.
- [Yak & Yeti: Yak gotta do what yak gotta do](https://www.ronijbarahi.com/work/yak-and-yeti): Identity for a Himalayan kitchen: yak and yeti mascots, menus, takeaway packaging, street banners and merch.
- [Empower Kind: It's connection](https://www.ronijbarahi.com/work/empower-kind): Identity for a disability support service: a looping ribbon that reads as connection, in a bright four colour system.
- [Frogging Nook: Connection over competition](https://www.ronijbarahi.com/work/frogging-nook): Identity for a crochet platform driven by its community built on the belief that connection is more powerful than competition.
- [Mr Gole: Mr Gole. Approved.](https://www.ronijbarahi.com/work/mr-gole): A personal brand for a food and travel vlogger: a bold wordmark, a yellow and blue palette, a character illustration, stickers and merch.
- [Breathless: Live the spirit of the Himalayas](https://www.ronijbarahi.com/work/breathless): A social campaign for a 14 day Everest Base Camp trek: black and white mountain photography, route maps and red Breathless markers.
